title: Juicy Moroccan Couscous Grill
description: A yeasty, molten quick-fix Moroccan dish that marries couscous with spiced apples and dried fruit, all cooked on a raclette grill.
instructions: Place couscous in a heat-protect bowl and sprinkle with 1 tsp salt; add 200ml hot water, stir, cover, and let it steam for 5 minutes on the raclette grill.
While the couscous steams, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan on the grill and sauté sliced apples with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and 0.5 tsp pepper until lightly browned.
Stir in 50g chopped apricots and 30g raisins and cook for another 2 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Drain excess water from the couscous, fluff with a fork, and transfer to a large mixing bowl.
Add the apple-apricot mixture, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and 1 tsp coriander to the couscous and gently mix until evenly coated.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over the mixture and toss lightly to coat.
Transfer the combined couscous to a preheated raclette grill tray and press gently to create a flat surface.
Grill the couscous for 6-8 minutes, flipping once, until the top is golden and slightly crispy.
Remove from the grill, sprinkle with additional pepper if desired, and serve hot as a fragrant Moroccan dinner.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves if available for a bright finish.
